{'text': 'Apple 宣佈 Vision Pro 上首部沉浸式恐怖片《Remnants》將於本週上映。以下是預告片。', 'paragraph_context': 'Apple has announced that ‘Remnants,’ the first immersive horror film on Vision Pro, is coming this week. Here’s a teaser video.'}

{'text': '恐怖片《Remnants》將於本週五登陸 Apple Immersive 的 Vision Pro', 'paragraph_context': '‘Remnants’ horror film comes to Vision Pro this Friday in Apple Immersive'}

{'text': 'Apple Immersive 是一種專為 Vision Pro 設計的獨特 180 度影片格式。雖然我們已經看過不少拍攝運動賽事及紀錄片風格短片的沉浸式影片，但 Apple 剛宣佈首部恐怖片即將上映。', 'paragraph_context': 'Apple Immersive is a unique 180-degree video format designed for Vision Pro. And while we’ve seen immersive videos that capture sports and plenty of documentary-style short films, Apple just announced the first horror film is coming soon.'}

{'text': '《Remnants》將於 10 月 16 日（星期五）於 Apple TV app 獨家登陸 Vision Pro 首播。', 'paragraph_context': 'Remnants premieres this Friday, October 16 in the Apple TV app exclusively on Vision Pro.'}

{'text': '《Remnants》由編劇兼導演 Ti West 執導，帶觀眾走進 Woldmere 城堡以及 West 所打造的「恐怖世界」。', 'paragraph_context': 'From writer and director Ti West, Remnants takes viewers inside Woldmere Castle and the “terrifying world” created by West.'}

{'text': '以下是 Apple 剛分享的預告片，展示觀眾的真實反應：', 'paragraph_context': 'Here’s a teaser video Apple just shared that shows real viewer reactions:'}

{'text': '如果你是恐怖片迷，Vision Pro 上的 Apple Immersive 應該能為觀賞這類型作品帶來與別不同的獨特體驗。', 'paragraph_context': 'If you’re a fan of horror, Apple Immersive on Vision Pro should make for an especially unique viewing experience for enjoying the genre.'}
